name: Proposal Sending Email
description: Send a proposal to a client after scope alignment.
subject: Proposal for {{projectName}}
body:
Hi {{clientName}},

Thank you for discussing {{projectName}} with me. I have prepared a proposal that outlines the project background, service scope, timeline, investment, and next steps.

The proposed investment for this work is {{currency}} {{price}}, with a target delivery date of {{dueDate}}.

Please review the proposal and let me know if you would like to move forward or discuss any adjustments.

Best,
{{businessName}}
{{businessEmail}}

name: Proposal Follow-Up Email
description: Follow up after sending a proposal.
subject: Following up on {{projectName}} proposal
body:
Hi {{clientName}},

I wanted to follow up on the proposal for {{projectName}} and check whether you have any questions about the scope, timeline, or investment.

I would be happy to clarify details or make reasonable adjustments before we confirm the next steps.

Best,
{{businessName}}

name: Project Kickoff Email
description: Start a project with a clear kickoff note.
subject: Kickoff for {{projectName}}
body:
Hi {{clientName}},

I am pleased to kick off {{projectName}}. The agreed service focus is {{serviceType}}, and the current target delivery date is {{dueDate}}.

To keep the project moving smoothly, I will use the agreed scope as our working reference:

{{scope}}

Please send any access, source materials, or key preferences that should be considered before work begins.

Best,
{{businessName}}

name: Payment Reminder Email
subject: Payment reminder for {{projectName}}
body:
Hi {{clientName}},

This is a friendly reminder regarding payment for {{projectName}}. The current amount due is {{currency}} {{totalAmount}}.

Payment information:
{{paymentInfo}}

Please let me know if you need the invoice resent or if there is anything else required from my side.

Best,
{{businessName}}

name: Project Delivery Email
description: Send final delivery materials to a client.
subject: Delivery for {{projectName}}
body:
Hi {{clientName}},

I am sharing the final delivery for {{projectName}}. The work has been prepared according to the agreed scope and service focus of {{serviceType}}.

Please review the materials and let me know if anything needs clarification. If revisions are included in our agreement, you can send consolidated feedback and I will confirm the next steps.

Thank you for the opportunity to work on this project.

Best,
{{businessName}}

name: Client Feedback Request Email
description: Ask for feedback after project delivery.
subject: Feedback request for {{projectName}}
body:
Hi {{clientName}},

Now that {{projectName}} has been delivered, I would appreciate your feedback on the process and final outcome.

If you are comfortable sharing a short testimonial, a few sentences about the project experience and results would be very helpful.

Thank you again for working with {{businessName}}.

Best,
{{businessName}}
